title: Witness length bound
statement: For natural numbers $C,c$ and a Boolean list $y$, define $w(C,c,y)=C\bigl(\operatorname{length}(\operatorname{pairFstD}(y))+1\bigr)^c$, where $\operatorname{pairFstD}(y)$ denotes the first component decoded from $y$.
caveat: The provided material does not define the decoding operation $\operatorname{pairFstD}$.
